description: The cold within him freezes his features: nipped nose, shrivelled cheek, stiffened gait, red eyes, blue lips, grating voice
Cratchit has only a single coal for his fire and cannot replenish it; he is reduced to warming himself at a candle and wearing his comforter indoors
Flushed and glowing from walking rapidly through cold fog and frost; face ruddy, breath visibly smoking
Scrooge buttons his great-coat to the chin before leaving
Scrooge has a cold in his head, as evidenced by the gruel prepared on the hob
Changed from outdoor coat into dressing-gown and slippers
Nightcap on, signalling full domestic undress
Long chain clasped about his middle, wound like a tail, made of cash-boxes, keys, padlocks, ledgers, deeds, and heavy steel purses
Body is transparent — visible through to the coat buttons behind
Folded kerchief bound about head and chin
Scrooge has gone to bed fully clothed in his dressing gown and nightcap, without undressing
The Ghost of Christmas Past has clasped Scrooge by the arm and laid its hand upon his heart, physically compelling him to rise and move toward the window
Scrooge is crying, moved to tears by the sight of his childhood home and schoolmates
Ghost of Christmas Past has seized Scrooge bodily and holds him fast, forcing him to watch
Overcome by irresistible drowsiness after wrestling with the Ghost; barely able to reel to bed
Seized by a violent fit of trembling while waiting for the Second Spirit to appear
Scrooge has taken hold of the Ghost of Christmas Present's robe at the Spirit's command
Bears a crutch and has his limbs supported by an iron frame
Wearing at least three feet of comforter hanging down before him on arrival
Hair has turned grey; the Ghost has visibly aged over the course of the night
Life ending at midnight; the Ghost expires as the bell strikes twelve
Legs trembling beneath him, barely able to stand
Scrooge shudders and feels very cold under the Phantom's unseen gaze
Shuddering from head to foot at the sight of the thieves dividing the dead man's belongings
Physically recoiling in terror at the proximity of the sheeted body, unable to bring himself to lift the covering
Face wet from sobbing during the conflict with the Spirit
Perfectly winded after frenzied movement through rooms
Scrooge's hand shakes badly enough to make writing the address and shaving difficult
Scrooge has changed out of nightclothes into his best day clothes
